Name: New NPC Schedule Fix
Author: GoodSmarts
Description:
[size=4]Sometimes when you add new expansion mod mid-save, you'll go to the new areas and NPCs are all stuck in bed. They fix themselves once you save and wake up the next day, but this mod makes those NPCs properly follow their schedules immediately.[/size]

[size=4]The issue happened to me installing East Scarp on my Year 2 save, just to give an example.

It's a small patch, most people probably don't need it, but here it is for anyone who wants it.[/size]

Manifest.Name: New NPC Schedule Fix
Manifest.Description: Fixes newly added NPCs standing still until the next day: they follow their schedule the day they first appear.
Manifest.Author: GoodSmarts
